brief: #137 swept laneCap 6.4 -> 10 -> 13 -> 16 and kept 10, because the east half did not respond to the cap at all. #144 changed that: `eastPull(cap)` now scales the four east bands 1x..2x between EAST_CAP0 6 and EAST_CAP1 14, and the sweep behind cue c230 says cap 10 -> 16 puts +1.02 people in the plaza. Re-price the ceiling — this is the follow-up #144 was explicitly forbidden to take. The law is that a cap and a share are two bounds and only one can be swept: re-weight, then RE-SWEEP, because the sweep is what reveals a ceiling that has stopped binding at all.
successLooksLike: A presence-per-place sweep names a knee, the shipped cap sits on it, the plaza / quay / church green / deck all gain, and crowded pairs per person stay inside their band.
avoid: Re-measure the +1.02 on HEAD first — it is a number from a cue, not from a run you did. Do not give any east destination its own new source; that is a bigger move than this brief and it wants its own. If the sweep says the ceiling is now a DEAD constant (identical numbers at two settings), that is a real result: ship the measurement and the finding, not a number change for its own sake.
